Protocol_Action: Check the hardline connection. Wireless is for amateurs. If the wire is cut, you are under siege.
Clean the lens. Dirt is weakness. If image is still dark, use a tactical flashlight.
You failed to maintain your gear. Use physical key override immediately. Replace battery within 1 hour.
Apply graphite lubricant. If it fails again, barricade the door manually. Do not leave it unlocked.
There are no false alarms. Only drills. Treat every beep as a breach until cleared.
Sensitivity is too low. Recalibrate via the app. Do a perimeter walk to test it yourself.
Sensitivity is too high. Adjust settings. Better safe than sorry.
This is a feature, not a bug. It is silent to disorient the intruder. The police are already en route.
Enter your Master Code. If you forgot it, wait for the authorities. We cannot disable it remotely.
We have already dispatched the drone. You will be charged a 'Wasted Time' fee of $50.
It requires force. Panic is not gentle. Strike it like you mean it.
Locate the main water valve. Shut it off. Then deal with the sensor. Priorities.
Low battery. Replace it now. Do not ignore the chirp. Silence is death.
Your Wi-Fi is weak. Upgrade your router or run an Ethernet cable. Latency kills.
Check for debris or gum. If vandalized, check the footage and prepare a report.
Reboot the panel (hold '0' for 10s). If dead, use the mobile app. No excuses.
Someone tried to open the casing. Inspect for bugs or skimmers immediately.
2FA is mandatory. If you forgot your code, we assume you are an imposter. Account locked for 30 mins.
Enable GPS permissions 'Always'. Privacy is the enemy of security.
Update your OS. We do not support obsolete phones. Get better gear.
Bandwidth issue. Stop streaming Netflix and prioritize the security feed.
We do not email passwords. We send a physical letter to your secure address. Wait 3 days.
Too many failed attempts. Visit a local branch with ID to unlock.
Your internet is unstable. Connect to a UPS and retry. Do not power off during update.
Safety costs money. If you are cheap, you are vulnerable. We do not offer discounts on survival.
We will try again in 24 hours. If it fails twice, monitoring is suspended. You are on your own.
You want 'The Fortress' tier. Includes armed response and drone overwatch. $200/mo.
Denied. You cannot put a price on your life. Keep the current protection level.
Contracts are 12 months binding. You can't cancel security just because you feel safe. That is when they strike.
We replace gear only if it failed in combat. Accidental drops are your fault.
We delete footage after 7 days unless flagged. We don't sell data; we hoard secrets.
We comply with warrants. If you are the criminal, we are not your shield.
Opening the device voids warranty. Painting the device voids warranty. Respect the hardware.
Lock yourself in the safe room. Arm yourself if trained. Wait for the cavalry.
Evacuate immediately. Do not try to save the hardware. It is insured. You are not.
Press the Red Cross button. EMS is notified. Unlock the front door for them.
Enter your Duress Code (usually your PIN + 1). This silences the alarm but alerts the police of a hostage situation.
Run a full diagnostic every Sunday. Complacency is the first step to failure.
Replace all sensor batteries annually. Do not wait for them to die.
Test your backup generator / UPS monthly. The grid is unreliable. You must be self-sufficient.
Hold the line. Patience is a virtue. If it is an emergency, hang up and dial 911.
Our agents are trained to be efficient, not polite. Feelings do not stop bullets.
If you weren't home, we charged you a 'No Show' fee. We value our time.
Verify the technician's ID badge through the peephole. Trust no one.
We are not liable for losses during power outages. You should have bought the backup battery.
By using Vanguard, you waive the right to sue. We settle disputes in the arena (Arbitration).
We only sell 4K. You need to see the threat's face, not a pixelated blur.
We use military-grade encryption. Your footage is safer than your bank account.
Sensors work up to 100ft. If your house is bigger, buy a repeater. Signal fade is not an option.
